scenes.conflict: Lena reports that the song has changed and that she hears it in her dreams. Voss's maternal obsession makes her downplay the danger, and Lena begins to doubt her.
scenes.goal: Voss wants to confirm that the Matriarch's song patterns match the contagion reports and to keep that finding hidden from her rivals.
scenes.outcome: Voss concludes the sentience is real and spreading through the water, and she decides to hide the full data and seek time to find a biochemical halt. Lena is left uneasy.
scenes.summary: In the warm brine-smelling Vat Halls, Voss and her apprentice compare the Matriarch's altered song to the dreams spreading among the staff. Voss recognizes the first sentient engineered mind and conceals what she knows.

scenes.conflict: Neighbors begin to sleepwalk and speak in unison, and Tomas's habit of avoiding confrontation makes him delay reporting. Every day of silence lets the infection spread through the shared water.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants to hide his shared dreams from supervisors and protect his family in the bunk-tunnels.
scenes.outcome: Tomas sees the warrens move as one voice and knows he cannot hide it much longer, but he still delays and decides to find someone who will listen instead of punish.
scenes.summary: Tomas watches the Worker Warrens begin to speak in one voice. He conceals his own symptoms and starts looking for a trustworthy contact.

scenes.conflict: Holm invokes the shareholder-protection rule to block any shutdown of production. Okafor reveals she has been watching his communications through the grown surveillance network.
scenes.goal: Okafor wants to get approval to seal infected sections, while Holm wants to keep the refinery running.
scenes.outcome: The two agree to an uneasy, deadline-bound delay before any sealing. Okafor secretly prepares quarantine seals without telling the others.
scenes.summary: In the Directorate Ring, Okafor and Holm clash over sealing sections versus protecting output. Each uses surveillance and leverage on the other, and a fragile delay is set.

scenes.conflict: Holm orders extended shifts and a full-scale gland harvest, which increases exposure to the contaminated water. Tomas cannot confront him openly.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to push the refinery crews to meet the quarterly enzyme target. Tomas wants to keep his crew safe from the song without exposing them.
scenes.outcome: The refinery crew starts to hum in unison during the shift, and Holm privately notices but suppresses his doubt and escalates the harvest. Tomas decides to send a warning to Okafor.
scenes.summary: Holm presses the Enzyme Works to harvest at maximum rate while Tomas watches his crew drift into the song. Holm sees the signs and ignores them.

scenes.conflict: Holm uses the shareholder-protection rule to override Voss's access, and Lena begins to question whether her calming of the Matriarch is her own will.
scenes.goal: Holm's team wants to start harvesting the Matriarch's glands, while Voss and Lena want to keep her calm and protected.
scenes.outcome: Voss keeps access only by promising a countermeasure by a set deadline. The Matriarch's song intensifies and the Chorus begins to gather at the Pen walls.
scenes.summary: Holm arrives at the Pen with harvest crews and a legal threat. Voss bargains for time while Lena senses the song getting stronger.

scenes.conflict: Okafor may have to quarantine Tomas and his family as vectors, and the Chorus pulls at Tomas to bring his children into the song.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants to pass a warning to Okafor and learn whether anyone can keep their individuality inside the Chorus. Okafor wants to measure how fast the contagion spreads.
scenes.outcome: Okafor learns that infected workers still have some agency and delays sealing the Warrens. Tomas agrees to act as a bridge.
scenes.summary: Tomas meets Okafor in the bunk-tunnels and tells her the Chorus speaks and thinks. She starts to doubt that the infected are lost.

scenes.conflict: Holm threatens to revoke Voss's access and demands harvest, Okafor wants to seal sections, and Voss refuses to let the Matriarch die. Each secretly plays the others against the tether-link deadline.
scenes.goal: Each department head wants the others to accept their plan to evacuate, destroy, or capture the Matriarch.
scenes.outcome: No agreement is reached, but Okafor and Voss form an uneasy alliance because Okafor needs Voss's chemistry. Holm is isolated.
scenes.summary: The three rivals confront each other in the boardroom. Voss and Okafor pair up against Holm's push to harvest.

scenes.conflict: Lena reveals she is hearing the song clearly and cannot be sure whether she is infected. Voss refuses to accept that her countermeasure would also harm the Matriarch.
scenes.goal: Voss wants to design an enzymatic countermeasure that halts the contagion without killing the Matriarch.
scenes.outcome: Voss produces a prototype that blocks transmission but damages the Matriarch's glands. Lena confronts her about the cost.
scenes.summary: In the Vat Halls, Voss and Lena build a countermeasure. Lena forces Voss to face what it would do to her creation.

scenes.conflict: The refinery crew turns against Holm's orders and speaks as one, while Okafor must decide whether to seal the infected workers in.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to keep the refinery running even as workers join the Chorus, and Okafor wants to seal the section before the contagion spreads further.
scenes.outcome: Holm loses his workforce to the Chorus. Okafor seals the section, sacrificing infected workers and accepting a loss she will carry as guilt.
scenes.summary: The Chorus takes the Enzyme Works. Okafor seals it, and Holm is left with a silent, humming refinery.

scenes.conflict: Tomas stands between the Chorus and the humans and risks losing himself. A breach in the Pen would flood the section within minutes.
scenes.goal: The Chorus wants to free the Matriarch, while Voss and Lena want to deliver the countermeasure before the membrane walls fail.
scenes.outcome: Voss accepts that the Matriarch cannot be saved intact. Lena and Tomas hold the line long enough for the countermeasure to be prepared.
scenes.summary: The Chorus gathers at the Pen walls and presses against the membrane. Voss, Lena, and Tomas have minutes to act.

scenes.conflict: Holm demands capture for the shareholders, Okafor fears that releasing infected workers would spread the contagion, and Voss must give up her creation.
scenes.goal: The department heads must decide between evacuating, destroying, or capturing the Matriarch, and Tomas brings the Chorus's message.
scenes.outcome: Holm confronts what the ledger cannot measure and yields. Okafor chooses a risky compromise of selective evacuation and the countermeasure, and Voss agrees to its use on the Matriarch.
scenes.summary: In the boardroom, the three leaders face the final choice with Tomas speaking for the Chorus. They agree to a compromise that spares as many lives as possible.

scenes.conflict: The countermeasure will harm the Matriarch, the Chorus resists, and any breach would flood the section in minutes.
scenes.goal: Voss and Lena want to deliver the countermeasure into the Pen water, and Okafor wants to seal the section before the breach.
scenes.outcome: The countermeasure is released, the Matriarch's song fades, and the section is sealed. The contagion's transmission stops, though many workers and the Matriarch are lost.
scenes.summary: Voss and Lena release the countermeasure while Okafor seals the section. The Matriarch's song fades and the hive mind weakens.

scenes.conflict: Some workers are lost and others remain half-merged. Okafor must weigh quarantine against the agency Tomas has shown the infected still have.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants to find out who in the Warrens kept their individuality, and Okafor wants to triage survivors and decide who is quarantined.
scenes.outcome: Okafor chooses supervised care over sealing, and Tomas chooses what he will give up to keep his family whole.
scenes.summary: In the bunk-tunnels, survivors wake from the song. Tomas and Okafor agree to supervised recovery instead of abandonment.

scenes.conflict: Holm faces a silent refinery and the doubt he suppressed, that the hive mind was a life he was liable for.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to account for the loss of output and protect his position before the tether link brings an audit.
scenes.outcome: Holm acknowledges what the ledger cannot measure and prepares an honest report. His career and standing are left uncertain.
scenes.summary: Alone in the idle refinery, Holm confronts his losses and the doubt he buried. He decides to file an honest report.

scenes.conflict: Voss has lost her masterpiece and Lena asks whether the song was ever a voice or an infection. Okafor's cooperation depends on Voss's honesty.
scenes.goal: Voss wants to decide what to preserve of the Matriarch's legacy, and Okafor wants a plan to hold the station until the tether brings help.
scenes.outcome: Voss gives up the patent claims in favor of the colony's survival, Lena stays on as handler for the remaining leviathans, and the three set a plan to wait for the surface response.
scenes.summary: In the Vat Halls, Voss chooses the colony over her legacy. The survivors prepare to hold Mariana Six until help arrives.

logline: When the Matriarch's contagious sentience turns Mariana Six's workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads, each answering to a different corporate backer, must choose between saving the station and its people or securing the creature for their shareholders before the pressure of the deep and the isolation of the tether doom everyone.
theme: What a life is worth when everything has a price
title: Abyssal Shares
